prose: A 2026 Ask HN revives the perennial request: a native dark mode for Hacker News. The poster points to the 2020 thread as proof of how much bikeshedding the question generates - a hundred solutions, Parkinson's Law of Triviality in action, and a detour into alligator metabolism - while arguing the usual defenses (workarounds, third-party apps) are janky: one iOS app flashes the page white between loads. The underlying complaint is that a site that should look like top still ships only a blinding default two decades into dark-mode ubiquity.
highlights: Ask HN: native dark mode for Hacker News, requested again in 2026
The 2020 thread had ~100 solutions - a bikeshedding case study
Existing workarounds dismissed as janky (one app flashes white between pages)
Complaint: a site that 'should look like top' ships only a light default
